limits: Linux Chromium with virtual mobile viewports, not physical iOS/Android or other engines.
Local browser tests use fallback fonts because of environment Google Fonts certificate trust.
Computed contrast checks are triage, not a full WCAG certification.
Dark-surface and SVG checks exclude approved game evidence mockups, raster photos/artwork and print-only output. Game text, state flows and WebGL load are checked separately.
Before/after text-style fingerprints do not claim pixel-identical rendering; the logo and icon colours intentionally change in both themes.
Notice deadlines use browser virtual time; visibility and history suspension are dispatched test events. Busy interactions defer notices.
